## Introduction

This script performs data extraction and cohort preparation for a retrospective
cohort study investigating the association between **proton pump inhibitor (PPI)**
versus **H2 receptor antagonist (H2RA)** prescription and **all-cause mortality**,
using simulated UK primary care electronic health record (EHR) data.

**Pipeline stage:** 1 of 2 — run via `3_run_pipeline.R`

---

## Section 1: Data Import

### Load libraries
```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

### Import datasets
```{r}
setwd("~/0. LSHTM - ALL MODULES/9. AEHR/Assessment")

# ---- Patient-level data files ----
# Dynamically read all CSV files from the Assessment_sample directory
# File naming convention: Sim_[TableName]_assessment_26.csv
files <- list.files("Assessment_sample", full.names = TRUE, pattern = ".csv")
filenames <- str_to_lower(str_remove(str_remove(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(files)), "_assessment"), "Sim_"))

# Apply the read_csv function to all files and save the output as one big list
data <- lapply(files, readr::read_csv)
names(data) <- filenames

# ---- Medical codelists ----
# Read all codelist CSVs used to identify conditions and prescriptions
files <- list.files("Codelists", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "codes.csv")
filenames <- str_to_lower(str_remove(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(files)), "_codes"))

# Apply the read_csv function to all files and save the output as one big list
codes <- lapply(files, readr::read_csv)
names(codes) <- filenames
```

### Data quality checks

Verify data integrity: check for duplicate patients, gender distribution,
event date ranges, and cross-table linkage.
```{r}
data$patient %>%
  summarise(n_rows = n(),
            n_patients = n_distinct(id))
# one row per patient

data$patient %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = prop.table(n))

# more females than males in this dataset - something to bear in mind

hist(data$contactdates$eventdate, "years")
# all looks okay

nrow(anti_join(data$patient, data$contactdates, by="id"))
nrow(anti_join(data$contactdates, data$patient, by="id"))
nrow(anti_join(data$clinic, data$contactdates, by="contactid"))
```

### Ensure categorical variables are factors
```{r}

factor_vars <- c("eth5", "contacttype", "ses_person", "gender")
# For all datasets
data <- map(data, ~.x %>% mutate(across(any_of(factor_vars), as_factor)))

# Set explicit ordering for SES (deprivation quintile)
data$ses$ses_person <- factor(data$ses$ses_person, levels = c("Least Deprived (1)", "2", "3", "4", "Most Deprived (5)"))
levels(data$ses$ses_person)
```

## Section 2: Study Design Overview

#### Study aim
To estimate the effect of proton pump inhibitor (PPI) prescription, versus a H2RA prescription, on subsequent all cause mortality.

#### Eligibility criteria
Patients whose records are held in our made-up database, who:

- Have recorded year of birth, sex, and ethnicity
- Have a first PPI or H2RA prescription that is:
    - After the date of the patient's registration at the general practice plus one year
    - Between 17 April 1997 and 17 April 2017

#### Exposure
PPI prescription versus H2RA prescription (first recorded prescription)

#### Confounders
- Age, sex, SES, calendar year of first prescription
- GERD in the 6 months prior to prescription
- Ethnicity, BMI
- Gastric cancer prior to prescription
- Peptic ulcer in the 6 months prior to prescription
- Number of healthcare contacts in the year prior

#### Follow-up
For each patient, follow-up begins at the first prescription for PPI or H2RA and ends at the first of: death, end of study (17 April 2017), or transfer out of the general practice.

#### Outcome
All-cause mortality

---

## Section 3: Cohort Eligibility and Exposure Assignment

### 3.1 Identify exposure groups and apply eligibility criteria
```{r}
# First label prescriptions with either PPI (1) or H2RA (0)
ppis <- data$prescription %>% 
  inner_join(codes$ppi, by="prescode") %>%
  mutate(ppi=1)

h2ras<- data$prescription %>% 
  inner_join(codes$h2ra, by="prescode") %>%
  mutate(ppi=0)

ppis_h2ras<-rbind(ppis, h2ras)

# Retain only the FIRST prescription per patient (index date)
cohort <- ppis_h2ras %>%  
  arrange(id, eventdate) %>%
  filter(!duplicated(id))
nrow(cohort)

# Apply registration eligibility: prescription must be >1 year after practice registration
cohort <- cohort %>% 
  left_join(data$patient[c("id", "start")], by="id") %>% 
  filter(eventdate > start+365.25) #
nrow(cohort)

# Apply study period eligibility: prescription between 17 Apr 1997 and 17 Apr 2017
cohort <- cohort %>% 
  filter(eventdate >= as.Date("1997-04-17") & eventdate <= as.Date("2017-04-17"))
nrow(cohort)

# Drop columns that aren't needed and rename eventdate to indexdate
cohort <- cohort %>% 
  select(id, eventdate,contactid, ppi) %>% 
  rename(indexdate=eventdate)
cohort

# Check Sex/YOB/Ethnicity completeness for additional eligibility
# NOTE: data$patient_26 may refer to a different naming convention in the data list;
# these names are derived from the filename suffixes during import
sum(is.na(data$patient_26$gender))
sum(is.na(data$patient_26$yob))
sum(is.na(data$patient_26$eth5))
table(data$patient_26$eth5)
table(data$patient_26$gender)
hist(data$patient_26$yob)
# no exclusions
```

### 3.2 Eligibility flowchart counts
```{r}
# The inbuilt library doesn't like adding exclusions that are 0
# make the flowchart externally using calculated numbers
table(cohort$ppi)
```

## Section 4: Confounder Extraction

### 4.1 Comorbidities (from clinical records)
```{r}
# 1. Diagnosis of gastric cancer EVER prior to index date
# 2. Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (GERD) in the 6 months prior to prescription
# 3. Peptic ulcer in the 6 months prior to prescription

# 1. Prior gastric cancer (ever before index date)
gastric_cancer <- data$clinic %>% 
  inner_join(codes$gastric_cancer, by="clincode") %>% 
  arrange(id, eventdate) %>% 
  filter(!duplicated(id)) %>% 
  inner_join(cohort, by="id") %>% 
  filter(eventdate < indexdate) %>% 
  mutate(prior_gcancer=1) %>% 
  select(id, prior_gcancer)

# 2. Recent GERD (within 180 days before index date)
recent_gerd <- data$clinic %>% 
  inner_join(cohort, by="id") %>% 
  arrange(id, eventdate) %>% 
  inner_join(codes$gerd, by="clincode") %>% 
  filter(eventdate>=indexdate-180 & eventdate<=indexdate) %>% 
  filter(!duplicated(id)) %>% 
  select(id) %>% 
  mutate(recent_gerd=1) 

# 3. Recent peptic ulcer (within 180 days before index date)
recent_ulcer <- data$clinic %>% 
  inner_join(cohort, by="id") %>% 
  arrange(id, eventdate) %>% 
  inner_join(codes$peptic_ulcer, by="clincode") %>% 
  filter(eventdate>=indexdate-180 & eventdate<=indexdate) %>% 
  filter(!duplicated(id)) %>% 
  select(id) %>% 
  mutate(recent_ulcer=1) 

```

### 4.2 Exploratory analysis: Prescription patterns and treatment switching

This section investigates prescription characteristics (quantity, daily dose,
duration, strength) and treatment switching between PPI and H2RA groups. This
is exploratory analysis to understand the data rather than part of the primary
analysis pipeline.
```{r}
# ---- Prescription characteristics ----
oac_all_prescriptions <- data$prescription %>%
  inner_join(codes$oac, by="prescode") 
ppi_all_prescriptions <- data$prescription %>%
  inner_join(codes$ppi, by="prescode")  
h2ra_all_prescriptions <- data$prescription %>%
  inner_join(codes$h2ra, by="prescode") 
# Quantity
par(mfrow=c(3,1))
hist(oac_all_prescriptions$qty, xlim=c(0,200), breaks = 200)
hist(ppi_all_prescriptions$qty, xlim=c(0,200), breaks = 200)
hist(h2ra_all_prescriptions$qty, xlim=c(0,200), breaks = 200)

oac_all_prescriptions %>%
  group_by(qty) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = prop.table(n))

ppi_all_prescriptions %>%
  group_by(qty) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = prop.table(n))

h2ra_all_prescriptions %>%
  group_by(qty) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = prop.table(n))

# Daily dose
oac_all_prescriptions %>%
  group_by(daily_dose) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = prop.table(n))

ppi_all_prescriptions %>%
  group_by(daily_dose) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = prop.table(n))

h2ra_all_prescriptions %>%
  group_by(daily_dose) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = prop.table(n))

# Duration (calculated as quantity / daily dose)
oac_all_prescriptions <- oac_all_prescriptions %>%
  mutate(duration=ifelse(daily_dose==0, NA, qty/daily_dose))
ppi_all_prescriptions <- ppi_all_prescriptions %>%
  mutate(duration=ifelse(daily_dose==0, NA, qty/daily_dose))
h2ra_all_prescriptions <-h2ra_all_prescriptions %>%
  mutate(duration=ifelse(daily_dose==0, NA, qty/daily_dose))

par(mfrow=c(3,1))
hist(oac_all_prescriptions$duration, xlim=c(0,200), breaks = 200)
hist(ppi_all_prescriptions$duration, xlim=c(0,200), breaks = 200)
hist(h2ra_all_prescriptions$duration, xlim=c(0,200), breaks = 200)

# Strength
table(oac_all_prescriptions$strength)
table(ppi_all_prescriptions$strength)
table(h2ra_all_prescriptions$strength)

#----------------------------------------------------------------------
# ---- Treatment persistence and switching ----
# Important for understanding potential misclassification of exposure

# PPI group: count subsequent PPI prescriptions per patient
ppi_group <- cohort %>% 
    filter(ppi==1) %>%
  select(ppi, id, indexdate)

# Pick out all PPI prescriptions given to patients in the ppi_group on or after study entry and count per patient
num_subs_ppi<-ppi_group %>% 
  inner_join(ppi_all_prescriptions, by="id") %>%
  filter(eventdate>=indexdate) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(n_presc=sum(ppi))

# Tabulate
num_subs_ppi %>%
  mutate(group_n_presc=ifelse(n_presc<10, n_presc, 10)) %>%
  group_by(group_n_presc) %>%
  summarise(n = n())%>%
  mutate(perc = prop.table(n))

# Plot
hist(num_subs_ppi$n_presc, breaks = 0:max(num_subs_ppi$n_presc))

# Same for H2RA group
h2ra_group <- cohort %>% 
  filter(ppi==0) %>%
  select(ppi, id, indexdate)

num_subs_h2ra<-h2ra_group %>% 
  inner_join(h2ra_all_prescriptions, by="id") %>%
  filter(eventdate>=indexdate) %>%
  mutate(h2ra=1) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(n_presc=sum(h2ra))

#Tabulate
num_subs_h2ra %>%
  mutate(group_n_presc=ifelse(n_presc<10, n_presc, 10)) %>%
  group_by(group_n_presc) %>%
  summarise(n = n())%>%
  mutate(perc = prop.table(n))

# Plot
hist(num_subs_h2ra$n_presc, breaks = 0:max(num_subs_h2ra$n_presc))

# ---- Treatment switching ----
# Identify patients who switched from PPI to H2RA (or vice versa) after index date

# PPI -> H2RA switchers
ppi_switchers<-ppi_group %>% 
  inner_join(h2ra_all_prescriptions, by="id") %>%
  filter(eventdate>indexdate) %>%
  arrange(id, eventdate) %>%
  filter(!duplicated(id)) %>%
  mutate(yrs_to_switch=as.numeric(eventdate-indexdate)/365.25) %>%
  rename(date_switch=eventdate) %>%
  select(id, ppi, yrs_to_switch, date_switch)

# Proportion who switched in PPI group
ppi_group %>% 
    full_join(ppi_switchers, by="id")  %>%
    mutate(switch=ifelse(is.na(yrs_to_switch), 0, 1)) %>%
    group_by(switch) %>%
    summarise(n = n())%>%
    mutate(perc = prop.table(n))
# Plot time to treatment switch (among those who do switch)
hist(ppi_switchers$yrs_to_switch)

# H2RA -> PPI switchers
h2ra_switchers<-h2ra_group %>% 
  inner_join(ppi_all_prescriptions, by="id") %>%
  filter(eventdate>indexdate) %>%
  arrange(id, eventdate) %>%
  filter(!duplicated(id)) %>%
  mutate(yrs_to_switch=as.numeric(eventdate-indexdate)/365.25) %>%
  rename(date_switch=eventdate) %>%
  select(id, ppi, yrs_to_switch, date_switch)

# Proportion who switched in H2RA group
h2ra_group %>% 
  full_join(h2ra_switchers, by="id")  %>%
  mutate(switch=ifelse(is.na(yrs_to_switch), 0, 1)) %>%
  group_by(switch) %>%
  summarise(n = n())%>%
  mutate(perc = prop.table(n))

# Plot time to switch (for those who switch)
hist(h2ra_switchers$yrs_to_switch)

# Store switching information for later use in defining censoring/follow-up
switchers <- rbind(ppi_switchers, h2ra_switchers)
switchers <- switchers %>% 
  select(!yrs_to_switch)
```

### 4.3 Demographics: BMI

BMI is derived from two sources: (1) directly recorded BMI values, and
(2) calculated from weight and height measurements. Both sources are restricted
to the 5 years prior to the index date. Extreme values outside plausible ranges
are excluded.

#### i) BMI from recorded values
```{r}

# BMI data entered directly (entity 17, data3 = BMI)

bmi_data <- data$clinic %>% 
  filter(entity==17) %>% 
  rename(bmi_date=eventdate) %>%
  inner_join(cohort, by="id") %>%
  inner_join(data$other, by= c("id", "entity", "otherid"))  %>% 
  rename(bmi=data3) %>%
  filter(between(as.numeric(indexdate-bmi_date), 0, 5*365.25)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(bmi), between(bmi, 9, 129)) %>% 
  group_by(id, bmi_date) %>%
  summarize(bmi = mean(bmi)) %>% 
  arrange(id, bmi_date) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(id)  %>%
  filter(bmi_date == max(bmi_date)) %>%
  mutate(preference=2) %>% 
  select(id, bmi, bmi_date, preference)

# Weight data (entity 17, data1 = weight in kg)

weight_data <- data$clinic %>% 
  filter(entity ==17) %>%  
  rename(weight_date=eventdate) %>%
  inner_join(cohort, by="id") %>%
  inner_join(data$other, by= c("id", "entity", "otherid"))  %>% 
  rename(weight_kg=data1) %>% 
  filter(between(as.numeric(indexdate-weight_date), 0, 5*365.25)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(weight_kg), between(weight_kg, 25, 635)) %>%
  group_by(id, weight_date)  %>%
  summarize(weight_kg = mean(weight_kg)) %>% 
  arrange(id, weight_date) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(id)  %>%
  filter(weight_date == max(weight_date)) %>% 
  select(id, weight_kg, weight_date)

# Height data (entity 18, data1 = height in metres)
height_data <- data$clinic %>% 
  filter(entity == 18) %>%
  rename(height_date = eventdate) %>%
  inner_join(cohort, by = "id") %>%
  inner_join(data$other, by = c("id", "entity", "otherid")) %>%
  rename(height_m = data1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(height_m), between(height_m, 1.20, 2.15)) %>%
  group_by(id, height_date) %>%
  summarize(height_m = mean(height_m), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  filter(height_date == max(height_date)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(id, height_m, height_date)

#--------------------------------------------
# Combine weight and height to calculate BMI (preference=1, preferred over recorded)
bmi_calculate <- inner_join(height_data, weight_data, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(
    bmi = weight_kg / height_m^2,
    bmi_date = weight_date,
    preference = 1
  ) %>%
  filter(between(bmi, 9, 129)) %>%
  select(id, bmi, bmi_date, preference)

# Combine both BMI sources, preferring calculated (preference=1) over recorded (preference=2)
bmi_combined <- bind_rows(bmi_data, bmi_calculate) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  arrange(preference, desc(bmi_date)) %>%
  filter(row_number() == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(id, bmi, bmi_date, preference)

# Coverage summary: how many cohort patients have BMI data?
cohort_bmi_check <- cohort %>%
  select(id) %>%
  mutate(
    has_recorded_bmi   = id %in% bmi_data$id,
    has_calculated_bmi = id %in% bmi_calculate$id,
    has_any_bmi        = id %in% bmi_combined$id
  )

# Check exclusions
cat("Total patients in cohort:", nrow(cohort_bmi_check), "\n")
cat("Patients with recorded BMI:", sum(cohort_bmi_check$has_recorded_bmi), "\n")
cat("Patients with calculated BMI:", sum(cohort_bmi_check$has_calculated_bmi), "\n")
cat("Patients with ANY valid BMI:", sum(cohort_bmi_check$has_any_bmi), "\n")
cat("Patients with NO valid BMI:", sum(!cohort_bmi_check$has_any_bmi), "\n")
cat("% coverage:", round(mean(cohort_bmi_check$has_any_bmi) * 100, 1), "%\n")
```

#### ii) Age, calendar year, sex, SES, ethnicity
```{r}
demographics <- cohort %>% 
  left_join(data$patient, by="id") %>%
  left_join(data$ses, by="id") %>% 
  mutate(age=round(as.numeric(indexdate-as.Date(paste0(yob, "-06-15")))/365.25),
         calendarperiod=case_when(indexdate<as.Date("2000-01-01") ~ "1997-1999",
                                  indexdate<as.Date("2005-01-01") ~ "2000-2004",
                                  indexdate<as.Date("2010-01-01") ~ "2005-2009",
                                  indexdate<as.Date("2015-01-01") ~ "2010-2014",
                                  indexdate>=as.Date("2015-01-01") ~ "2015-2017")) %>% 
  rename(pracid=pracid.x) %>%
  select(id, pracid, age, gender, ses_person, calendarperiod, eth5)
demographics
```


#### iii) Number of healthcare contacts in the year prior to index date
```{r}
# Explore contact type data
# NOTE: data$contactdates_26 refers to the imported name from filename convention
unique(data$contactdates_26$contacttype)
sum(is.na(data$contactdates_26$contacttype))

# Define eligible contact types (face-to-face and telephone consultations)
eligible_contacts <- c("Surgery consultation", 
                        "Follow-up/routine visit", 
                        "Clinic", 
                        "Telephone call from a patient", 
                        "Acute visit", 
                        "Home Visit", 
                        "Emergency Consultation")

# Count contacts per patient in the 365 days before the index date
no_contacts <- data$contact %>%
  inner_join(cohort, by = "id") %>%
  filter(contacttype %in% eligible_contacts) %>%
  filter(eventdate >= indexdate - 365 & eventdate < indexdate) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarize(n_contacts = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Left join to cohort so patients with zero contacts get a 0 instead of NA
no_contacts <- cohort %>%
  select(id) %>%
  left_join(no_contacts, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(n_contacts = ifelse(is.na(n_contacts), 0, n_contacts))

hist(no_contacts$n_contacts)
```

## Section 5: Follow-up Time and Outcome

Define the end of follow-up for each patient as the earliest of: death, transfer
out of practice, or study end date (17 April 2017). Treatment switching dates
are also recorded for potential sensitivity analyses.
```{r}
enddates <- cohort %>% 
  left_join(data$patient, by="id") %>% 
  mutate(enddate=pmin( 
    as.Date("2017-04-17"),
    pmin(leavepractice, deathdate, na.rm = TRUE),
    na.rm = TRUE),
    died=ifelse(is.na(deathdate), 0, (deathdate==enddate))) %>% 
  select(id, deathdate, enddate, died)
enddates

# Merge switching information
enddates <- enddates %>% 
  left_join(switchers[c("id", "date_switch")], by="id") 
enddates

# Check how many patients have no switch date (i.e. did not switch treatment)
sum(is.na(enddates$date_switch))
```

---

## Section 6: Final Merged Analysis Dataset

Merge all extracted variables into a single analysis-ready dataset.
```{r}
# check if cleaning required
analysis_data <- cohort %>% 
  left_join(gastric_cancer, by="id") %>% 
  left_join(recent_gerd, by="id") %>% 
  left_join(recent_ulcer, by="id") %>% 
  left_join(enddates, by="id") %>% 
  left_join(demographics, by="id") %>% 
  left_join(no_contacts, by="id") %>% 
  left_join(bmi_combined, by="id") %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = c("prior_gcancer", "recent_gerd", "recent_ulcer"),
                .fns = ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), 0, 1)))
analysis_data

# Check for missing values and NAs
# Overall missingness summary
cat("Total patients:", nrow(analysis_data), "\n\n")

# Count NAs in each column
na_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  summarize(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_missing") %>%
  mutate(pct_missing = round(n_missing / nrow(analysis_data) * 100, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_missing))

print(na_summary)
```

### Remove patients with missing BMI

Patients without any valid BMI measurement (recorded or calculated within 5 years
of their index date) are excluded from the analysis.
```{r}
analysis_data <- analysis_data[!is.na(analysis_data$bmi), ]
```

---

## Section 7: Export Final Dataset
```{r}
saveRDS(analysis_data, file = "analysis_data.Rds")
```
